llama-modchip (v3.0)

 Unified 16 GB · 32 GB · 64 GB MaxQ Inference Engine for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next , DeepSeek-V4 284B & Nemotron-3.5 30B 
 100% Donor-Free MaxQ Compression · Built-In NextN MTP + Stockfish-PVS v2 · Zero-Collision v3.0 ABI · Linux, macOS Metal, CUDA, Vulkan & Windows 11 

 
 
 %20%C2%B7%206.86%20(284B)%20%C2%B7%20100%2F100%20(30B)-2ea043?style=flat-square)
 
 
 
 

 Quickstart ( ./modchip setup ) · 3-Tier RAM Matrix · Gate 4 & 4D-1 Benchmarks · Engine Architecture ( v3.0 ) · Supported Hardware · Leaderboard · FAQ 

 
 
 3.4325 PPL · 0.4971 KLD Qwen3.8 MaxQ-64GB (-46.6% KLD vs Competitor) 
 26.91 GiB ≤ 28.5 GiB Qwen3.8 MaxQ-32GB Cgroup v2 Verified 
 12.66 / 14.29 tok/s Qwen3.8 Draft-MTP CPU Decode (0 GPU) 
 57.99 GiB (284B) DeepSeek-V4 MaxQ-v4 Donor-Free 
 24.2–111.6 tok/s Nemotron-30B 16GB CPU/Hybrid 
 19–38.5 ms /dev/shm Hybrid State Restore 
 0 GPUs Required 
 
 

 

---

 The 3-Tier MaxQ v3.0 RAM Matrix

One unified llama-modchip v3.0 binary ( GLIBC (Flagship Default) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-64GB ( --preset qwen38-64gb · opt-in qwen38-64gb-ablit , Heretic-2 + MTP) 53.99 GiB ( 57,969,748,352 B ) ( 43.26 Trunk + 10.73 PLE) 45.08 GiB ( RssAnon = 1.81 GiB ) 72.0 t/s pp512 12.66 t/s tg128 ( 93.0% MTP) 100% Standard ggml ( types ( 284B Alternative) DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-MaxQ-v4 ( --preset dsv4-maxq · 284.3B Total / 13.2B Active) 57.99 GiB ( 62,270,037,248 B ) ( 3 shards, 34L ConeCollapse) 58.6–59.1 GiB (anonymous heap) 36.1–44.4 t/s pp 8.8–19.2+ t/s tg ( ngram-simple ) 100% Standard ggml ( 0 custom types: CPU, Metal 27.0 t/s M5 Max, CUDA, Vulkan) 
 32 GB Tier (Consumer Default) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-32GB ( --preset qwen38-32gb · opt-in qwen38-32gb-ablit , Heretic-2 + MTP) 35.71 GiB ( 38,341,683,424 B ) ( 24.98 RAM + 10.73 lazy NVMe PLE) 26.91–28.40 GiB (Cgroup v2 Swap=0 PASS) 74.6 t/s pp512 11.45–14.29 t/s tg128 ( draft-mtp ) 100% Standard ggml ( types (CPU-Turbo / GPU) Nemotron-3.5-30B-A3B-VQ3-64 ( v3.0 CPU-Turbo) Nemotron-3.5-30B-A3B-MaxQ-16GB (Std ggml ) (opt-in nemotron-ablit ) 13.30 / 13.39 GiB ( 1 file, 256K Mamba-2+MoE) 14.30–16.0 GiB ( 14.30 GiB MaxQ-16GB : 188.3 pp / 15.10 t/s N=1 ( 27.80 refactor) VQ3-64 : v3.0 ( types 44/45 ) MaxQ-16GB : 100% Upstream ggml ( llama.cpp , Metal, CUDA, LM Studio) 

---

 Quickstart

 1-Command Setup & Interactive Chat (Linux, macOS & Windows)

 

Or bootstrap directly on a clean Linux host without cloning manually:

 

 Direct Portable Binary Run ( GLIBC 2.30 Linux x86 64 -avx512 / -avx2 )

All 12 v3.0 Linux x86 64 binaries link libstdc++ , libgcc , and libgomp.a statically ( NEEDED = [libdl.so.2, libpthread.so.0, libm.so.6, libc.so.6, ld-linux-x86-64.so.2] , max glibc [!IMPORTANT]
 Critical Runtime Best Practices ( v3.0 ): 
 - Non-Convoy Threading ( -t $((N CORES - 1)) -tb $((N CORES - 1)) --poll 0 --poll-batch 0 ): Leaving 1 core free for HTTP/OS dispatch and disabling busy-polling eliminates thread-pool barrier convoys ( +25.9% pp512 , +31.3% tg128 over oversubscribed -t N --poll 50 ). ./modchip configures this automatically.
 - Vocabulary Isolation ( RC TABLES DIR=/nonexistent on Non-Nemotron Models): When serving Qwen3.8 ( 248K vocab) or DeepSeek-V4 ( 129K vocab) from a working directory containing ./workspace/routecrack Nemotron tables, always set RC TABLES DIR=/nonexistent (not merely unset) so Stockfish-PVS v2 runs in clean online 248K session mode. ./modchip enforces this automatically.
 - Default --repack ON ( v3.0 ) vs. Unpatched Upstream llama.cpp : llama-modchip v3.0 fixes upstream CPU REPACK q8 cache / repack.cpp bugs while preserving zero-copy mmap on 3D MoE tensors ( RssAnon = 1.81–1.92 GiB , 93.0% MTP accept on MaxQ-64GB ). Users loading Qwen3.8 GGUFs on unpatched upstream llama.cpp should pass --no-repack ( -nr ); --no-repack is not needed on llama-modchip v3.0 .
 - MaxQ-32GB Anti-Repetition Sampling & Token Budgets: At 1.63 bpw , MaxQ-32GB and MaxQ-32GB-Abliterated must be run with temperature=0.6 , top p=0.95 , top k=20 , presence penalty=0.2 – 1.0 , repeat penalty=1.05 ( 4 / 4 = 100% loop-free on Blind-4 vs. greedy temp=0 tail loops without penalties; ./modchip passes these flags automatically on 32 GB presets). Whenever enable thinking=True , set max tokens = 16384 on Qwen3.8 and max tokens = 4096 on Nemotron-3.5 (whose default Jinja template enables ... unless enable thinking: false / --reasoning-budget 0 is passed).

 [!CAUTION]
 Responsible-Use Disclaimer & Edition Positioning (Opt-In -ablit Presets): Optional abliterated checkpoints ( qwen38-64gb-ablit , qwen38-32gb-ablit , nemotron-ablit ) remove upstream safety refusal filters ( qwen38- -ablit v3.0-r2 applies signed multi-layer Gated-Residual over-projection beta = 1.83 - 2.39 across blk.31..47 from trohrbaugh/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-heretic-2 [ 0 / 100 refusals at 0.0818 KLD] + signed beta = 2.2508 blk.48 NextN MTP alignment). Upstream refusal filters cannot be relied upon for moderation, and ./install.sh never selects -ablit presets without explicit [y/N] confirmation (or --accept-abliterated in --yes mode). Use Aligned qwen38-64gb as the default pure coding flagship, and reserve -ablit strictly for authorized security research, reverse engineering, red-team auditing, CTF, code auditing, and uncensored legal/policy analysis.

 ./modchip Command Description 
 :--- :--- 
 ./modchip setup Auto-detects RAM tier ( 16 / 32 / 64 GB ) & CPU ISA, installs v3.0 engine + SHA-256 verified GGUF 
 ./modchip download-bin Installs portable GLIBC 2.30 Linux x86 64 -avx512 or -avx2 v3.0 binary 
 ./modchip start / stop Starts or stops background llama-server ( :8789 ) + Agentic SSE Gateway ( :8787 ) 
 ./modchip chat Interactive terminal chat with live tok/s , TTFT, and Draft-MTP / Stockfish-PVS telemetry 
 ./modchip web Opens the Dark-Mode Web Chat & Live Telemetry HUD ( 
 ./modchip bench Runs a 2-stage C++20 + Refactor benchmark and prints a shareable CPU Scorecard

install.html:
1-Command Setup & Interactive Chat (Linux, macOS & Windows)
git clone https://github.com/synchopate/llama-modchip.git
cd llama-modchip
./modchip setup    # Auto-detects 16GB / 32GB / 64GB RAM + CPU ISA, verifies SHA-256, writes start_server.sh
./modchip chat     # Starts background server + SSE Gateway (:8787) and opens live streaming terminal chat

Or bootstrap directly on a clean Linux host without cloning manually:

curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/synchopate/llama-modchip/main/install.sh | bash
Direct Portable Binary Run (GLIBC_2.30 Linux x86_64 -avx512 / -avx2)

All 12 v3.0 Linux x86_64 binaries link libstdc++, libgcc, and libgomp.a statically (NEEDED = [libdl.so.2, libpthread.so.0, libm.so.6, libc.so.6, ld-linux-x86-64.so.2], max_glibc <= 2.30, 0 %zmm instructions in -avx2, 0 vdpbf16ps in -avx512):

# 1. Auto-select -avx512 (Zen 4/5, Ice Lake+) or -avx2 (Haswell+, Zen 1-3, Alder/Raptor Lake) and verify SHA-256:
BIN_ISA=$(grep -q "avx512f" /proc/cpuinfo && grep -Eq "avx512_?vbmi" /proc/cpuinfo && grep -Eq "avx512_?vnni" /proc/cpuinfo && echo "avx512" || echo "avx2")
curl -fLO "https://github.com/synchopate/llama-modchip/releases/download/v3.0/llama-server-modchip-linux-x86_64-${BIN_ISA}"
curl -fLO "https://github.com/synchopate/llama-modchip/releases/download/v3.0/SHA256SUMS"
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
chmod +x "llama-server-modchip-linux-x86_64-${BIN_ISA}"

# Non-convoy thread count: leave 1 physical core free for HTTP/OS threads paired with --poll 0 --poll-batch 0
N_CORES=$(lscpu -p=CORE,SOCKET 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | sort -u | wc -l)
THREADS=$(( N_CORES > 1 ? N_CORES - 1 : 1 ))

# 2A. [64 GB Tier Default] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-64GB (53.99 GiB, default --repack ON, NextN draft-mtp -> 12.66 t/s):
hf download Synchopate/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-64GB-GGUF \
  --include "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-64GB-*.gguf" --local-dir ./qwen38-64gb
env RC_TABLES_DIR=/nonexistent "./llama-server-modchip-linux-x86_64-${BIN_ISA}" \
  -m ./qwen38-64gb/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-64GB-00001-of-00002.gguf \
  -c 32768 -np 1 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --spec-type draft-mtp --jinja \
  -t "$THREADS" -tb "$THREADS" --poll 0 --poll-batch 0 --slot-save-path /dev/shm --port 8080

# 2B. [32 GB Tier Default] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-32GB (24.98 GiB Shard 1 + lazy NVMe PLE -> 26.9 GiB RSS, 11.45-14.29 t/s):
hf download Synchopate/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-32GB-GGUF \
  --include "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-32GB-*.gguf" --local-dir ./qwen38-32gb
env RC_TABLES_DIR=/nonexistent "./llama-server-modchip-linux-x86_64-${BIN_ISA}" \
  -m ./qwen38-32gb/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MaxQ-32GB-00001-of-00002.gguf \
  -c 32768 -np 1 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --spec-type draft-mtp --jinja --ctx-checkpoints 0 \
  --temp 0.6 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --presence-penalty 0.2 --repeat-penalty 1.05 \
  -t "$THREADS" -tb "$THREADS" --poll 0 --poll-batch 0 --slot-save-path /dev/shm --port 8080

# 2C. [16 GB Tier] NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-30B-A3B-VQ3-64 (v3.0 CPU-Turbo) or MaxQ-16GB (100% standard ggml):
# ./install.sh --preset nemotron-vq3         # 13.30 GiB v3.0 CPU-Turbo (AVX-512 VBMI)
# ./install.sh --preset nemotron-maxq-16gb   # 13.39 GiB 100% standard ggml (CPU / Metal / CUDA / LM Studio)

[!IMPORTANT] Critical Runtime Best Practices (v3.0):

  • Non-Convoy Threading (-t $((N_CORES - 1)) -tb $((N_CORES - 1)) --poll 0 --poll-batch 0): Leaving 1 core free for HTTP/OS dispatch and disabling busy-polling eliminates thread-pool barrier convoys (+25.9% pp512, +31.3% tg128 over oversubscribed -t N --poll 50). ./modchip configures this automatically.
  • Vocabulary Isolation (RC_TABLES_DIR=/nonexistent on Non-Nemotron Models): When serving Qwen3.8 (248K vocab) or DeepSeek-V4 (129K vocab) from a working directory containing ./workspace/routecrack Nemotron tables, always set RC_TABLES_DIR=/nonexistent (not merely unset) so Stockfish-PVS v2 runs in clean online 248K session mode. ./modchip enforces this automatically.
  • Default --repack ON (v3.0) vs. Unpatched Upstream llama.cpp: llama-modchip v3.0 fixes upstream CPU_REPACK q8_cache / repack.cpp bugs while preserving zero-copy mmap on 3D MoE tensors (RssAnon = 1.81–1.92 GiB, 93.0% MTP accept on MaxQ-64GB). Users loading Qwen3.8 GGUFs on unpatched upstream llama.cpp should pass --no-repack (-nr); --no-repack is not needed on llama-modchip v3.0.
  • MaxQ-32GB Anti-Repetition Sampling & <think> Token Budgets: At 1.63 bpw, MaxQ-32GB and MaxQ-32GB-Abliterated must be run with temperature=0.6, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, presence_penalty=0.2–1.0, repeat_penalty=1.05 (4 / 4 = 100% loop-free on Blind-4 vs. greedy temp=0 tail loops without penalties; ./modchip passes these flags automatically on 32 GB presets). Whenever enable_thinking=True, set max_tokens >= 16384 on Qwen3.8 and max_tokens >= 4096 on Nemotron-3.5 (whose default Jinja template enables <think>...</think> unless enable_thinking: false / --reasoning-budget 0 is passed).

[!CAUTION] Responsible-Use Disclaimer & Edition Positioning (Opt-In *-ablit Presets): Optional abliterated checkpoints (qwen38-64gb-ablit, qwen38-32gb-ablit, nemotron-ablit) remove upstream safety refusal filters (qwen38-*-ablit v3.0-r2 applies signed multi-layer Gated-Residual over-projection beta = 1.83 - 2.39 across blk.31..47 from trohrbaugh/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-heretic-2 [0 / 100 refusals at 0.0818 KLD] + signed beta = 2.2508 blk.48 NextN MTP alignment). Upstream refusal filters cannot be relied upon for moderation, and ./install.sh never selects *-ablit presets without explicit [y/N] confirmation (or --accept-abliterated in --yes mode). Use Aligned qwen38-64gb as the default pure coding flagship, and reserve *-ablit strictly for authorized security research, reverse engineering, red-team auditing, CTF, code auditing, and uncensored legal/policy analysis.

./modchip Command Description
./modchip setup Auto-detects RAM tier (16 / 32 / 64 GB) & CPU ISA, installs v3.0 engine + SHA-256 verified GGUF
./modchip download-bin Installs portable GLIBC_2.30 Linux x86_64 -avx512 or -avx2 v3.0 binary
./modchip start / stop Starts or stops background llama-server (:8789) + Agentic SSE Gateway (:8787)
./modchip chat Interactive terminal chat with live tok/s, TTFT, and Draft-MTP / Stockfish-PVS telemetry
./modchip web Opens the Dark-Mode Web Chat & Live Telemetry HUD (http://127.0.0.1:8787)
./modchip bench Runs a 2-stage C++20 + Refactor benchmark and prints a shareable CPU Scorecard
./modchip claude Launches Claude Code CLI wired to the local engine with /dev/shm Slot-0 warm restore
./modchip eval / status Runs the 100-point Functional Gate or inspects CPU readiness, 2MB THP, and /dev/shm IPC
